external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: A person who browses and places sock orders through the mobile app and receives faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The marketing staff who maintain the catalogue spreadsheet and its macros.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and place orders.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app, which keeps customer records and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: Fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that receives dispatch notes, dials the number stored against the order, and faxes confirmations.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer
processes.notes: Nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: Spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database holding customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file kept alongside SIMS containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: Catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet used by Marketing to keep the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_stores.name: Marketing laptop
data_stores.description: The office laptop where the catalogue spreadsheet lives.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customers browse and place orders through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: place order
data_flows.description: The mobile app sends customer orders to the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
data_flows.data_description: Customer order, including customer and payment-related information

data_flows.name: hand order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
data_flows.data_description: Dispatch note containing the customer's name and address

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: Confirmation containing the customer's name and address

data_flows.name: change catalogue
data_flows.description: The spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: Office
trust_boundaries.description: The office network location where the marketing laptop and catalogue spreadsheet are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The user database contains confidential data because it holds customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file contains confidential data because it holds delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses.

assumptions.assumption: The catalogue spreadsheet contains confidential business data because it holds prices and product copy.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the spreadsheet contains the catalogue, including prices and product copy.
